evidence.supports: class relief was not settled until after earlier fee negotiations

summary: Plaintiff first raised a fee amount in its opening public term sheet, and fee terms were negotiated in package proposals before the final class relief was accepted. The transcript does not show class counsel weighing its own fee economics, accepting less class relief for firm benefit, defense leveraging fee interest, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration. The declaration does not claim fees were discussed only after class relief was agreed.
